info.name: Secure Movie Library – Smoke Tests (Fixed)
info.description:
Smoke-test suite for Secure Movie Library FastAPI app.

KEY FIXES vs v1:
- Login uses application/x-www-form-urlencoded (OAuth2PasswordRequestForm)
- Register uses application/json (custom Pydantic body)
- Token capture uses pm.response.json() with null-guard
- Removed 'Register ADMIN' — seed the first admin directly in the DB via seed_admin.py

PRE-REQUISITES:
1. App is running at baseUrl (default http://localhost:8000)
2. A seed ADMIN account exists in the DB — set adminUsername + adminPassword variables to match
3. Run the collection in order (folder by folder)

item.name: 1.13 Login again after password change – re-capture adminToken
1.16 Restore USER role back to USER
3.0  [Seed] ADMIN creates movie for USER read tests
3.6  USER cannot update another user's role → 403
4.1  Create movie – response must be immediate (< 3 s)
4.2  Poll after 5 s – expect OMDb rating enriched
